jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

CWA: Civil Works Alliance is a leading organization dedicated to delivering high-quality civil construction and infrastructure development services. With a strong reputation for excellence, innovation, and integrity, we serve a diverse range of clients across the public and private sectors. Our team is committed to sustainable practices, safety, and exceeding client expectations through innovative solutions and meticulous project execution. As a company, we prioritize professional growth, collaboration, and community engagement, fostering an environment where talent thrives and impactful projects are realized.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Civil Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing various stages of civil infrastructure projects, from planning and design to execution and completion. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise, excellent project management skills, and a keen eye for detail. You will collaborate closely with clients, contractors, and internal teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful infrastructure projects that enhance communities and support sustainable development.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field from an accredited institution. A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in civil construction, infrastructure projects, or related areas is required. Professional Engineering (PE) license or equivalent certification is preferred. Strong knowledge of civil design software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or similar tools is essential. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and project management skills are vital for success in this role. Candidates should demonstrate a thorough understanding of safety regulations, environmental standards, and quality assurance processes relevant to civil engineering projects.

Responsibilities

Lead and coordinate civil engineering projects from conception through completion, ensuring adherence to project specifications, timelines, and budgets. - Develop detailed project plans, including scope, schedules, and resource allocation. - Conduct site inspections to monitor progress, quality, and safety compliance. - Collaborate with architects, contractors, and other stakeholders to facilitate effective communication and problem resolution. - Prepare and review technical reports, drawings, and project documentation. - Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, including environmental and safety standards. - Manage procurement processes, including evaluating bids and selecting contractors and suppliers. - Monitor project costs and implement corrective actions to address budget variances. - Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members. - Maintain comprehensive records of project activities and progress for reporting and future reference.

Benefits

CWA: Civil Works Alliance offers a competitive compensation package aligned with industry standards. Employees enjoy comprehensive health insurance, including medical, dental, and vision coverage. We provide opportunities for professional development through training programs, certifications, and career advancement initiatives. Our organization values work-life balance and offers flexible working arrangements where possible. Additionally, employees benefit from a collaborative and inclusive work environment that promotes innovation, recognition, and personal growth. We are committed to supporting our team members in achieving their career goals and fostering a positive workplace culture.

Equal Opportunity

CWA: Civil Works Alliance is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our recruitment and employment practices are designed to promote fairness and equal opportunity, ensuring that every individual has the chance to contribute and succeed within our organization.

jobs.title: Regional Digital Project Manager
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER
is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.  
As a part of The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  
Role:
Regional Digital Project Manager
Location:
Singapore

About the role:

Join our dynamic team as a Regional Digital Project Manager, where you'll be integral to delivering website, email and push content across multiple languages for our largest fashion client, based in APAC .  
As Regional Digital Project Manager, you’ll be accountable & responsible for all the regional client communication for content delivery. You will liaise with the client’s team to accurately forecast, produce, and deliver the content across multiple channels (AEM, Push, Email) as per the defined SLA.   
You’ll be responsible for leading the region to manage & deliver campaigns along with the Web Content Manager and off-site Digital Project Manager. You’ll act as a Primary Contact for all the regional clients to set up regional processes and improvements in AEM work-stream. Excellent communication and attention to detail is required to deliver to the highest standards.   
This role is right for you if y ou’re someone who thrives on shared successes, especially as part of a team that’s making waves with innovative processes & high-volume delivery. Unexpected turns energise you, and you take challenges head-on, inspiring your entire team to find solutions and stay the course. Your positive spirit keeps your sleeves rolled up, always ready to seize every opportunity.    
You’ll be the kind of person who is driven by managing large volume campaigns curating timelines and motivating your team ensure high quality delivered with maximum efficiency. You’ll be confident with clients and can think on your feet. You relish in adding value throughout the end-to-end process, adding your unique touch at every turn.     
Ideally, you’ll have experience in large-scale accounts in FMCG industries, such as Beauty or Fashion and experience across multiple channels .  
You’ll already be a Digital Project Manager, looking for bigger challenges on a larger account where you can hone your existing skills on optimising processes and workflows in a fast pace environment, as well as cultivat ing new ones .  

What you will be doing:

Serving as the primary point of contact and digital expert for clients throughout the lifecycle of a digital project is a key responsibility.   
Responsible for managing digital projects across the AEM workstream; from initial briefing to final delivery.  
Effectively managing the team to successfully deliver email marketing and website content deliverables.  
Developing and nurturing strong client relationships through transparent communication and the establishment of trust is paramount.   
Follow and implement best practice production processes established within OLIVER, fostering collaboration with the client on-site to optimize operational efficiency.  
Efficient planning and scheduling of projects are essential to ensure optimal resource utilization.  
Regular communication of project status, both internally and externally, in accordance with agreed-upon account processes.  
Produce estimates and timelines and measure progress of projects against those throughout the workflow.  
Be able to verify the qualitative and quantitative output of a project against the project objectives.  
Proactively identifying and addressing potential issues at the onset of a project, while also managing and mitigating project risks, are critical functions.   
Support the business to develop technical excellence by suggesting improvements to bring efficiency in the way or working and processes.   
Fostering a collaborative and motivational environment to ensure team members remain focused on delivering high-quality work and feel supported is essential.  
Ensure administration tasks are maintained to the same high standard as the rest of your work.  
Ensuring accurate timekeeping and project status updates for both oneself and the team within MPC to facilitate data reporting for the client & Account Lead.  

What you need to be great in this role:

Excellent communication & Attention to detail  
5+ years' experience managing digital projects from initial briefing to delivery.   
Good understanding and working knowledge of AEM or similar enterprise level CMS.  
Competent user of Microsoft Office software, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint  
Experience in Site Content Publishing and Creation is a plus  
Hands-on experience working on PM tools like JIRA, Trello, etc  
Good understanding of project finances – estimating, timings, costs and invoicing.  
Passion for and inquisitive about AI and new technologies  
Understanding and knowledge of AI tools is beneficial, but ability to learn and digest benefits and features of AI tools is critical

jobs.description:
Overview

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Senior Program Analyst to support enterprise observability and logging services programs supporting critical federal operations. This position provides programmatic, operational, and process support for large-scale Splunk and enterprise logging initiatives, ensuring effective coordination between technical teams, stakeholders, and government customers. The Senior Program Analyst supports Agile delivery processes, change management activities, requirements tracking, documentation development, operational reporting, and program governance activities while helping ensure successful execution of sustainment and modernization efforts. This position will be fully remote within the United States.

Responsibilities

The Senior Program Analyst serves as a key member of the program management team supporting enterprise logging, monitoring, and observability services. This role coordinates Agile delivery activities, facilitates communication between technical and business stakeholders, manages program documentation and operational processes, and helps ensure engineering teams remain aligned with program priorities and customer requirements. The analyst supports sprint execution, change management, requirements management, operational reporting, and process improvement activities in support of enterprise Splunk and Elastic services and related modernization initiatives.

Design and configure a SharePoint site for use by various stakeholders
Coordinate training for stakeholders to use Elastic
Coordinate Agile sprint activities, daily standups, planning sessions, retrospectives, and backlog management activities.
Support development, review, refinement, and tracking of user stories, requirements, and work items.
Monitor and track program activities to ensure alignment with schedules, priorities, and customer requirements.
Support change management processes, including coordination, documentation, and tracking of infrastructure and application changes.
Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure completion of operational deliverables, documentation, and process requirements.
Develop, maintain, and update SOPs, process documentation, implementation guides, and other program artifacts.
Support operational reporting, metrics collection, dashboards, and program status reporting.
Assist with ServiceNow workflow management, process coordination, and operational support activities.
Support onboarding and offboarding activities for program personnel.
Coordinate training, knowledge management, stakeholder communications, and user engagement activities.
Maintain program records and artifacts within Jira, ServiceNow, SharePoint, and other collaboration platforms.
Support sustainment and modernization initiatives involving enterprise logging, monitoring, and observability services.
Provide backup support for Scrum Master, Product Owner, and other program management functions as required.
Collaborate with government stakeholders, program leadership, and technical teams to ensure successful program execution.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience:

Bachelor's with 2-5 years (or commensurate experience)
SharePoint configuration and design
Must have the ability to understand enterprise logging and cloud systems. Needs to be able to proactively identify gaps in training and provide feedback to the training team
Excellent skills working with customers and stakeholders
Experience supporting Agile teams, sprint planning, backlog management, and work tracking activities.
Experience using Jira, ServiceNow, or similar project and workflow management tools.
Experience supporting change management and operational process improvement activities.
Experience developing and maintaining SOPs, process documentation, reports, and program artifacts.
Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams

Clearance Required:
Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMP, PMI-ACP, or similar certification.
Extensive ServiceNow administration or operational experience.
Experience supporting federal government programs.
Experience supporting IT operations, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or observability programs.
Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management practices.
Experience supporting training, knowledge management, and stakeholder engagement initiatives.

[조직 소개]
저희 ​조직은 ​무신사·29CM ​등 무신사 ​커머스 플랫폼에서 고객과 파트너가 ​신뢰할 ​수 있는 ​거래 환경을 만드는 ​TnS(Trust & ​Safety) ​조직입니다. 대내외 ​리스크를 ​선제적으로 ​감지해 대응하고, 지식재산권 ​침해, ​가품·택갈이, 자사몰·직거래 유도 ​등 ​파트너 ​정책 위반과 고객·파트너의 ​어뷰징 및 ​이상거래(Fraud)를 ​관리합니다. 안전거래센터를 ​운영하며 위반 ​유형 ​정의부터 탐지와 제재까지 ​일관된 기준으로 ​운영되는 체계를 설계하고, 데이터와 AI를 활용해 플랫폼 차원의 리스크를 구조적으로 줄여가고 있습니다.

[담당 업무]
파트너 출고 준수 현황을 모니터링하고, 출고 지연·장기 미출고 등 고객 피해로 이어질 수 있는 파트너에 대한 관리 기준과 개선 조치를 운영합니다.

반품·클레임 어뷰징 등 이상거래 유형을 정의하고, 데이터 분석을 통해 탐지 기준과 대응 프로세스를 개선합니다.
위반·제재 데이터를 분석해 판단 기준을 정비하고, 반복 업무 중 자동화가 필요한 영역을 발굴합니다.
안전거래센터 운영, 지식재산권 침해 대응 등 플랫폼 전반의 안전거래·신뢰 관리 업무를 수행합니다.

Ottimate operates in the AI-powered automation space, focusing on streamlining financial operations and spend management for businesses. The organization addresses challenges related to integrating financial workflows by providing a platform that connects with ERP, accounting, and procurement systems, enabling improved operational efficiency and scalability.

This role emphasizes managing outcomes over timelines by defining successful implementation standards, developing consistent methodologies, and ensuring the team delivers customer value at scale. It serves as a key liaison across multiple functions to align customer expectations with delivered results and evolves in scope alongside organizational growth.

Responsibilities:

Lead and develop a team of Implementation Managers and Enablement Consultants with a focus on accountability and customer outcomes
Coach team members through feedback and skill development to enhance performance and growth
Establish clear expectations and performance standards for the team
Develop and maintain implementation methodology focused on outcome-driven delivery
Create and update playbooks, frameworks, and escalation guides to improve quality and efficiency
Address delivery risks and complex client issues as an escalation point
Ensure comprehensive documentation of implementation knowledge
Consult with customers to support organizational change during adoption
Engage leadership-level customers to build confidence in the implementation process
Adapt to ambiguity and maintain alignment among customers and internal teams
Identify and resolve root causes of implementation delays
Collaborate with Solution Architects, Customer Success, Product & Engineering, and Sales to ensure smooth transitions and alignment
Represent implementation in leadership discussions on processes and roadmaps
Manage team capacity, resource allocation, and workload
Define and monitor key metrics related to implementation success
Contribute to strategic planning for the Services organization as it scales

7+ years in SaaS implementation, professional services, or customer onboarding with 3-4 years in leadership
Proven experience building or improving implementation practices
Preferred experience with accounts payable, procurement, or financial operations workflows
Experience with ERP or accounting systems such as Sage Intacct, NetSuite, Acumatica, or Microsoft BC is a plus
Expertise in change management for customers and internal teams

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Toku, we create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions to reimagine customer experiences for enterprises. We provide an end-to-end approach to help businesses overcome the complexity of digital transformation and deliver mission-critical CX through cloud communication solutions. Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional in-country infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve the diverse needs of enterprises operating at scale. Headquartered in Singapore, Toku supports customers across APAC and beyond, with a growing footprint across global markets. As a publicly listed company, Toku continues to scale its presence and impact across international markets.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you will lead the successful delivery of complex enterprise system integration projects across APAC and global markets, acting as the primary delivery owner for clients, partners, vendors and internal teams. Beyond project execution, you will help strengthen project management standards, mentor less experienced project managers, and drive greater operational maturity as Toku continues to scale internationally. Success in this role depends on combining strong technical understanding with excellent stakeholder management, commercial awareness, sound project governance, and the ability to adapt across different countries, time zones and customer environments.

What you will be doing

Enterprise Project Delivery:
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technical implementation and system integration projects, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within budget and to agreed quality standards across multiple workstreams.
Project Planning & Governance:
Own integrated project plans covering scope, schedules, budgets, dependencies, assumptions, resources, milestones and governance activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Technical Leadership:
Work confidently with solution architects, consultants and engineering teams to understand technical designs, infrastructure, cloud environments and integration approaches, enabling informed delivery decisions and effective issue resolution.
System Integration:
Manage complex integration programmes involving enterprise platforms, contact centre technologies, CRM solutions, cloud services and connectivity components while ensuring all technical deliverables align with client requirements.
Stakeholder Management:
Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers, government stakeholders where applicable, internal delivery teams, partners and vendors by providing clear communication, governance and proactive expectation management.
Resource & Delivery Management:
Coordinate project resources across multiple countries and functions, balancing delivery priorities while maintaining visibility of resource utilisation, delivery risks and overall project health using Jira and related project management tools.
RAID Management:
Own project risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies by identifying potential delivery challenges early, driving mitigation plans and escalating blockers before they impact project outcomes.
Testing & Go-Live:
Coordinate testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), production readiness and deployment activities with consulting, engineering and client teams to ensure successful implementation and transition into production.
Commercial & Financial Oversight:
Monitor project budgets, effort burn, payment milestones, commercial commitments and change requests, ensuring delivery remains commercially sustainable while providing early visibility of potential impacts.
Project Reporting:
Produce accurate executive-level reporting covering project progress, delivery status, financial health, governance updates, risks, decisions and next steps for both customers and internal leadership.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales and Solution Engineering to provide delivery insights, identify commercial risks, support solution transitions into delivery, and highlight opportunities for additional services or change requests where appropriate.
Continuous Improvement:
Help strengthen project management methodologies, reporting standards, governance frameworks and delivery consistency as Toku scales its global project delivery capability.
Mentoring & Leadership:
Mentor and coach less experienced project managers, promote best practices, and provide senior project leadership across the wider delivery organisation.
Global Delivery:
Successfully manage projects across multiple countries and regions while remaining flexible to collaborate across different time zones and travel internationally when required.
AI & Automation:
Continuously identify opportunities to improve project delivery through AI-powered reporting, workflow automation, Copilot agents and other productivity tools that reduce administrative effort and improve delivery effectiveness.

We'd love to hear from you if you have

Experience:
5–10 years of project or programme management experience delivering complex enterprise technology or system integration projects.
Project Management Certifications:
PMP or PRINCE2 certification is required.
Enterprise Delivery:
Strong experience delivering projects for medium to large enterprise organisations, with exposure to large stakeholder environments and structured delivery methodologies.
Technical Background:
Practical experience managing technical implementations involving system integration, infrastructure, cloud platforms and enterprise software, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions without necessarily being a hands-on engineer.
Project Governance:
Extensive hands-on experience using Jira for project planning, delivery tracking, governance and reporting.
Cloud Technologies:
Experience delivering projects involving cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Contact Centre & Communications Technologies (preferred but not required):
Practical knowledge of CCaaS, CPaaS, CTI, enterprise contact centre architectures and the wider cloud communications industry, including familiarity with major vendors such as Genesys, Avaya and similar platforms.
Enterprise Platforms:
Experience delivering or integrating enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow and Salesforce. Familiarity with Remedy/BMC or similar enterprise service management platforms would also be advantageous.
Connectivity & Telecommunications:
Experience within telecommunications, network infrastructure or connectivity-related projects would be highly valued, particularly where enterprise provisioning or carrier integrations have been involved.
CRM & Enterprise Applications:
Experience working with CRM platforms and enterprise business applications across cloud and on-premise environments.
Agile Delivery:
Experience working within Agile software delivery environments and collaborating closely with engineering teams.
IT Understanding:
Good practical understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management practices.
AI Productivity:
Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve project delivery, reporting, workflow automation or operational efficiency within day-to-day project management activities.
Industry Experience:
Experience supporting government, public sector or healthcare customers would be advantageous. Experience with Singapore Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) environments would be considered a strong advantage.
Communication:
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead governance discussions and manage complex client relationships.
Working Style:
Comfortable working across international time zones, travelling internationally when required, and adapting to the needs of global enterprise project delivery.
Location:
This role is to be based in KL, Malaysia, operating on a Hybrid work mode of WFO and WFH

Toku has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Startup and by the Financial Times as one of APAC’s Top 500 High Growth Companies. If you’re looking to be part of a company on a strong growth trajectory while working on meaningful, real-world challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About The Equity Group Foundation

Equity Group Foundation (EGF) is the social impact implementing arm of the Equity Group Holdings. EGF aims to transform the lives and livelihoods of the people of Africa socially and economically by equipping them, capacity building and linking them to modern, inclusive financial services that maximize their opportunities. Since its inception, EGF has led high-impact development programs in East and Central Africa in the fields of Education and Leadership Development; Food and Agriculture; Enterprise Development and Financial Inclusion (ED&FI); Energy, Environment & Climate Change; Social Protection; and Health. EGF has adopted Innovation & Technology as a leverage to expand its reach, efficiency in program delivery and impact at scale, as well as Advocacy to advance social change through awareness, mobilizing partnerships and championing relevant policy change.

The Role Purpose

Reporting to the Pillar Lead, the Program Manager is responsible for the design, implementation, performance management, and continuous improvement of Enterprise Development & Financial Inclusion programs that drive enterprise growth, financial inclusion, innovation, and sustainable economic opportunities. The role translates strategy into scalable, technology-enabled interventions that strengthen enterprise capability, improve productivity, expand access to finance, strengthen market participation, and support business growth among MSMEs, youth, women, and other underserved populations. The Program Manager provides technical leadership in assigned thematic areas while leveraging technology, data, ecosystem partnerships, and innovation to achieve impact at scale. The role also ensures strong governance, risk management, compliance, financial stewardship, and operational controls to safeguard program integrity and maximize value for beneficiaries, partners, donors, and Equity Group stakeholders.

The Key Responsibilities

Support the design and delivery of programs within the Enterprise Development pillar that aligns with the strategic objectives of EGF under assigned thematic areas.
Lead the design, planning, implementation, and continuous improvement of ED&FI programs and initiatives within assigned thematic areas.
Drive enterprise growth, job creation, financial inclusion, and livelihood improvement outcomes through effective delivery of capacity building, business development, market linkage, and financial access interventions.
Manage program performance, budgets, work plans, risks, compliance requirements, and reporting to ensure quality, efficiency, and achievement of program targets.
Build and manage strategic partnerships with donors, government agencies, financial institutions, private sector players, ecosystem actors, and development partners to strengthen program delivery and sustainability.
Provide technical leadership and thought leadership within assigned practice areas, contributing to innovation, program development, and resource mobilization efforts.
Lead, coach, and develop high-performing program teams while promoting a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
Oversee monitoring, evaluation, learning, knowledge management, and impact measurement processes to support evidence-based decision-making and program effectiveness.
Champion business growth and financial inclusion by facilitating access to finance, market opportunities, digital solutions, and relevant enterprise support services for beneficiaries.
Develop stakeholder reports, impact stories, knowledge products, and management updates that effectively communicate program achievements, lessons learned, and strategic value.
Represent EGF in relevant forums, partnerships, and ecosystem engagements while strengthening the visibility and positioning of the ED&FI pillar.

Core Accountabilities And Deliverables

Financial: Program budget preparation, management, and utilization, Resource mobilization and partnership development, Contribution to customer acquisition, financial inclusion, and access-to-finance outcomes, Support growth in enterprise financing and uptake of financial services.
Processes: Quality program design and implementation, Delivery against approved work plans, budgets, and targets, Compliance with organizational policies, donor requirements, and audit standards and accurate, timely, and actionable reporting
Customers and clients: Delivery of impactful enterprise development and financial inclusion interventions, Increased customer satisfaction, enterprise growth, and financial capability, strengthened access to finance, markets, and business support services, enhanced inclusion of youth, women, and underserved segment.
People: Supervision and development of program staff, Performance management, coaching, and mentorship, Team engagement, capability building, and succession planning, Promotion of a high-performance and learning culture

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years' progressive experience in enterprise development, financial inclusion, entrepreneurship, innovation, economic development, or related program management.
Proven experience leading complex programs, partnerships, budgets, and multidisciplinary teams, delivering measurable business, development, or financial inclusion outcomes.
Experience leveraging technology, digital platforms, data, or innovation to improve program effectiveness and scale.
Familiarity with innovation, digitalization and demonstrated ability to identify and nurture innovative solutions and opportunities in enterprises.
Strong understanding of entrepreneurship for economic and social outcomes, the MSME sector in Kenya, East and Central Africa region.
Demonstrated experience managing risks, controls, compliance requirements, and governance processes within donor-funded, financial services, or development environments.
Experience supporting growth-oriented enterprises to improve competitiveness, access markets, attract finance, and scale operations will be an added advantage.
Experience designing and implementing entrepreneurship, startup, innovation, youth employment, or future skills programs will be an added advantage.
Master’s degree in; Entrepreneurship/Development Finance/Economics/Development studies & related business fields.
Professional certification in Project Management, Enterprise Development, Financial Inclusion, Entrepreneurship Development, or related field.
Mandatory Certification in ILO Start & Improve Your Business (SIYB).
Certifications such as IFC Business Edge, UNCTAD Empretec, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile Project Management, or equivalent will be an added advantage.
PhD in a relevant field will be an added advantage.

jobs.description:
There is only one city in the country that can say it is the Nation’s Capital – Washington, D.C. Given that distinction, The Metropolitan Police Department is the premiere law enforcement organization in the city. We receive over 22 million visitors a year, have almost 700,000 residents, and 21,000 private business. The Department consists of more than 4,200 members: approximately 3,550 sworn members and over 650 civilian employees. We are one of the most diverse and highly trained departments in the country. We have the honor of safeguarding and protecting not only our nation’s residents, but also people from all over the world.

The Metropolitan Police Department (MPD) offers an attractive benefits package. The benefits package includes competitive compensation, health insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability and life insurance, as well a strong retirement benefit and savings options. Employees are also eligible for our employer contributed 401a plan after one year of employment. Additional perks such as discounts on wireless carriers, gym memberships, amusement park tickets and much more! Additional information can be found at: DCHR Benefits

This position is located in the Metropolitan Police Department (MPD), Technical Services Bureau (TSB), Technology Division Chief Information Officer, Customer Support Branch. The mission of MPD is to safeguard the District of Columbia and protect its residents and visitors with the highest regard for the sanctity of human life. We will strive at all times to accomplish our mission with a focus on service, integrity, and fairness by upholding our city’s motto, Justitia Omnibus – Justice for All.

The (TSB) oversees all information technology services, as well as records management, fleet services and evidence control of the IT component of the bureau include software development, data quality and compliance, business application development, and information technology program management. The Records Division provides services like fingerprinting, gun registration, and background checks.

The Program Manager provides strategic leadership, operational oversight, and program management for the Department’s Body-Worn Camera (BWC) and Evidence Retrieval (CCTV) programs. These programs directly support mission-critical public safety operations. The incumbent manages technology systems, personnel, vendor relationships, budgets, compliance requirements, and operational processes to ensure reliability, effectiveness, and continuous improvement. The position serves as a key member of the TSB management team and contributes to organizational strategy, planning, and performance initiatives.

The Incumbent Will Be Responsible For The Following

Serving as a member of the MPD-TSB management team, and in that capacity engages and contributes to the overall performance matrix, strategy, planning, and any other discussion or subject that improves the overall functionality and operational health of the department.
Overseeing and managing the performance efforts related to assigned systems for the MPD BWC and Evidence Retrieval programs; and mapping out project plans from multiple groups. Maintaining support and troubleshoots programs used, including, but not limited to: Axon, Fusus, and drone support.
Leading matrixed teams and cross-functional initiatives to deliver enterprise solutions; providing tactical and strategic leadership for assigned programs; and working with peer organizational leaders in IT, vendors, and client business partners to provide and maintain a robust system solution.
Developing and managing program resource requirements for the Body-Worn Camera (BWC) and digital evidence programs, including budget projections, equipment lifecycle and replacement requirements, software licensing, vendor services, system maintenance, storage capacity, staffing requirements, and planned technology enhancements. Monitoring expenditures and resource utilization; identifying anticipated funding needs and cost risks; and developing recommendations to support annual budget formulation, procurement planning, and long-range program sustainability.
Providing technical and operational recommendations to MPD leadership and appropriate policy officials regarding the technology-related provisions of BWC and digital evidence policies. Evaluating system capabilities, configuration options, operational requirements, data integrity controls, evidence-management practices, and emerging technologies and recommends changes that improve transparency, accountability, system reliability, evidentiary integrity, and compliance with applicable legal and Department requirements.
Coordinating with the Customer Support Branch to establish service delivery and technical support expectations for BWC and digital evidence systems, including incident response, service request resolution, user access and account support, equipment troubleshooting, escalation procedures, system availability, and resolution of recurring technical issues.
Establishing service priorities and performance expectations for issues affecting sworn and civilian users and monitors support trends to identify systemic problems requiring corrective action, system enhancement, additional training, or escalation to vendors or other TSB technical components.
Coordinating with IT Infrastructure and Engineering, Desktop Support, Cybersecurity, Network Operations, application support personnel, MPD operational components, procurement and contracting personnel, vendors, and other technical stakeholders to plan and implement BWC and digital evidence system deployments, upgrades, integrations, maintenance activities, and operational improvements. Ensuring technical dependencies, security requirements, interoperability, resource requirements, schedules, and operational impacts are identified and addressed.
Collaborating with shareholders to plan for integration, improved operability, gather requirements, and maintain a high level of support for business operations. Developing, overseeing, and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) governing BWC and digital evidence program operations to ensure consistent processes, accountability, regulatory compliance, and adherence to MPD policies and technical requirements.
Developing, reviewing, and updating Statements of Work (SOWs) for contracts and procurements supporting BWC and digital evidence systems, including system implementation, maintenance, technical support, upgrades, integrations, equipment, software, and professional services. Defining technical requirements, deliverables, performance standards, service-level expectations, timelines, and acceptance criteria to ensure contracted services meet MPD operational and program requirements.
Partnering with MPD operational commanders, investigative units, business owners, TSB leadership, technology managers, cybersecurity personnel, records and evidence stakeholders, legal and policy officials, and external technology partners to establish program requirements, priorities, implementation strategies, and service expectations for BWC and digital evidence systems. Facilitating resolution of competing operational and technical requirements and elevates significant risks, resource constraints, or policy issues to appropriate leadership for decision.
Developing and presenting program performance reports, dashboards, risk assessments, and executive briefings regarding BWC and digital evidence operations. Reporting on system performance, project milestones, vendor performance, service issues, budget status, compliance concerns, operational risks, and corrective actions to the DCIO, TSB leadership, and other authorized stakeholders.
Managing vendor and third-party relationships supporting BWC and digital evidence systems. Monitoring vendor performance against contractual requirements and service-level expectations; coordinating system maintenance, upgrades, technical support, and issue resolution; evaluating vendor recommendations; and escalatimg significant performance, security, contractual, or operational concerns through appropriate management and procurement channels. Leading the identification, analysis, documentation, and prioritization of business and technical requirements for BWC and digital evidence system enhancements, new functionality, integrations, and interfaces. Working with operational users, technical personnel, system owners, vendors, and other stakeholders to translate mission and business needs into defined system requirements and implementation priorities.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Project Manager to own delivery execution across our technology teams. You take the prioritized backlog and make delivery happen planning and tracking the work, running the sprint process, keeping Jira clean, coordinating the people, and acting as the tech team's face to business stakeholders.
This is a pure project management and delivery role. You are the person who keeps everyone aligned, unblocked, and on schedule, and who represents the technical team's status and constraints clearly to the business.

Key Responsibilities
Delivery planning & tracking
·      Take the prioritized backlog and turn it into an executable sprint / release plan.
·      Track progress against timelines, milestones, and commitments; keep delivery on schedule.
·      Manage risks, dependencies, and blockers proactively surface slippage early with options.

Jira & project tooling management
·      Own Jira day to day boards, workflows, sprint setup, ticket hygiene, and accurate status.
·      Ensure every task moves through its states cleanly, and nothing stalls silently.
·      Maintain dashboards and delivery reports as a single source of truth for status.

People & team management
·      Coordinate developers and QA across workstreams; manage capacity, allocation, and follow-ups.
·      Keep the team unblocked and accountable; drive tasks to completion.
·      Run the sprint ceremonies planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

Stakeholder communication (tech team's face to business)
·      Represent the technical team to business stakeholders communicate delivery status, timelines, and technical constraints in terms the business can act on.
·      Manage expectations on scope, timelines, and change; negotiate when capacity is tight.

Quality & release
·      Ensure testing and release readiness are planned in advance, not left to the last day.
·      Coordinate deployments and releases with Engineering and QA.

Process & governance
·      Establish and continuously improve lightweight delivery processes suited to a fast-moving company.

Required Qualifications
·      Strong hands-on experience with Agile and day-to-day Jira management.
·      Proven track record coordinating cross-functional teams and managing people to deliver on time.
·      Solid understanding of the software delivery lifecycle enough to hold credible conversations with engineers and QA and to explain constraints to the business.
·      Excellent written and verbal communication.

Core Skills
·      Delivery planning, scheduling, and tracking.
·      Jira administration, sprint management, and delivery reporting.
·      People and team coordination; driving accountability.
·      Risk, dependency, and blocker management.
·      Stakeholder management and clear status communication.
·      Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Emotional Intelligence & Behavioural Competencies

· A two-way bridge, and a balanced advocate. You carry the tech team's status and constraints to business stakeholders, and business context back to the team representing both sides fairly. You do not consistently push the pressure onto one side; you find the trade-off that works for the goal.

· Composed under pressure. When timelines, scope, and expectations collide, you stay calm and solution focused. You absorb pressure and convert it into clear next steps, rather than passing panic down to the team or frustration up to stakeholders.

· Empathetic, and a genuine listener. You understand the real concerns behind what each side is saying the business's urgency and the team's constraints and you listen before you react.

· A positive, ownership-driven attitude. Proactive, accountable, dependable, and humble. You bring solutions, not just problems — and people trust you because both sides feel genuinely heard.

· Resilient and adaptable. You stay steady and constructive through changing priorities and tight cycles.

· Experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Digital Transformation Project)
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Digital Transformation (DT) Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of MR DIY's digital and software initiatives spanning the mobile app, e-commerce, website, middleware, and supporting enterprise systems. The role plans, coordinates, and drives projects from initiation to closure, ensuring they are delivered on scope, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards across multiple markets.

Working closely with product owners, engineering teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, the DT Project Manager translates business and technical requirements into structured delivery plans, manages dependencies and risks, and provides clear visibility of progress to leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Delivery
Develop and review business cases – lead the formulation and evaluation of comprehensive project business cases including ROI calculations and detailed costing to ensure financial alignment with strategic goals
Plan and drive delivery — build project plans, work breakdown structures, and schedules for digital/software implementation projects, from initiation through go-live and hypercare.
Manage scope, schedule, and budget — track progress against baseline, manage the change-control process for scope changes, and report cost and schedule variances.
Coordinate cross-functional delivery — align business analysts, developers, QA, vendors, and operations teams around a shared plan and shared milestones.

Testing & Quality Assurance
Apply testing-phase knowledge — understand unit, integration, system, regression, and UAT testing phases well enough to plan realistic test cycles and set clear exit criteria for each stage.
Partner with vendor and QA teams — work closely with vendor delivery teams and internal QA to make sure test coverage spans all angles — functional, integration, performance, security, and regression — not just the happy path.
Validate go-live readiness — review test results and defect burn-down against agreed exit criteria, and confirm sign-offs are in place before approving deployment.

Risk & Issue Management
Identify risks early — proactively surface technical, resourcing, vendor, and dependency risks during planning and throughout delivery, not just when they materialize.
Maintain a live risk register — log each risk with owner, likelihood, impact, and mitigation/contingency plan; review and update it on a regular cadence.
Track and escalate — monitor risk status through to closure, escalate material risks to sponsors and steering committees promptly, and report issue logs with root cause and resolution status.
Manage dependencies — map cross-project and cross-team dependencies and sequence delivery to avoid downstream schedule risk.

Project Checklists, Compliance & Governance
Maintain project checklists — work through structured stage-gate and go-live checklists covering compliance, security, data privacy, and operational readiness at each project milestone.
Uphold governance — ensure projects follow PMO standards, stage-gate approvals, and architectural, data, security, and compliance requirements before sign-off.

Change Management & Readiness
Coordinate change management — work with business owners, change management lead, and operations to build a change management plan covering communication, training, and support ahead of go-live.
Ensure training and SOP readiness — partner with relevant parties to confirm user training is delivered and SOPs are updated and in place so the organization is genuinely ready to adopt the new system, not just technically live.
Track benefits realization – Establish post-go-live monitoring to track benefits and KPIs, ensuring the solution achieves the outcomes defined in the original business case

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Manage stakeholders — run steering committee updates, status reporting, and decision forums; keep sponsors informed with clear, honest status (green/amber/red) rather than optimistic reporting.
Manage vendors — oversee external delivery partners against contracted scope, quality, and timelines; manage vendor-side risk and escalations.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
5to 8 years of experience managing software or enterprise-wide digital/IT implementation projects (exact minimum to be confirmed by hiring manager).
Demonstrated track record delivering software projects end-to-end — from initiation through go-live — on schedule and within budget.
Hands-on experience maintaining project risk registers and issue logs, with a track record of catching and mitigating risk before it hits delivery.
Working knowledge of software testing phases (unit, integration, system, regression, UAT) and how each fits into an implementation timeline.
Working knowledge of both Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery approaches, and judgment on when to apply each.
Experience managing vendors or external delivery partners, including coordinating vendor and QA teams on test coverage.
Experience running change management activities for software rollouts — training coordination, SOP updates, and readiness sign-off
Project management certification preferred
Proficient in English and Bahasa Malaysia. Mandarin proficiency is an added advantage

About WeRize

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segments not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

Marketing impact measurement

Define campaign objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement plans before launch for festive and thematic campaigns, brand initiatives and on-ground events.

Evaluate return on investment (ROI) and the duration of campaign impact, using cost and profit definitions agreed with Finance. Combine sales analysis with brand health and survey findings to recommend improvements to campaign strategy and spending.

Loyalty experimentation and customer analytics

Design and evaluate A/B tests for loyalty offers, push notifications, rewards and customer journeys. Define hypotheses, eligibility, randomised test and control groups, sample sizes, test duration, success metrics and commercial safeguards before launch.
Measure incremental conversion, repeat purchase, visit frequency, basket value, retention and reactivation. Assess contribution after reward and campaign costs, and recommend whether to scale, refine or stop a test.
Analyse customer segments, cohorts and purchase behaviour to identify growth opportunities. Monitor member acquisition, engagement, points and voucher redemption, lapsing and customer lifetime value where the available data supports reliable estimates.

Business intelligence and daily analytics

Extract, clean, validate and analyse sales, store, product, marketing and customer data. Investigate data quality issues and deliver accurate recurring reports and timely ad hoc analysis for management and business teams.

En tant que Business Analyst Supply Chain - Customer Care & Continuous Improvement, vous rejoignez l'équipe Customer Care au sein de Supply Chain Excellence et jouez un rôle clé dans l'amélioration continue des services de la Supply Chain.

Vous contribuez à la structuration, l'optimisation et l'évolution du processus Customer Care en analysant les demandes, incidents, plaintes et signaux remontés par les clients internes de la Supply Chain. Votre objectif est d'identifier les causes racines, de transformer les données en informations exploitables et de contribuer à la mise en place d'améliorations structurelles en collaboration avec les différentes entités de la Supply Chain, notamment I-SC.3 Supply, Procurement, Production, Energy et Supply Chain Excellence.

Vous participez à la gestion, la structuration et l'amélioration continue du processus Customer Care.

jobs.description:
"the Great Educational Equalizer"

— Philosopher Johnathan Bi, on Alpha School

Alpha is hiring.

The best leaders don't measure success by what they accomplish themselves. They measure it by what the people around them achieve.

If you've run youth programs, built the staff and systems behind them, and hold people to a high bar while getting them to exceed it, this role offers the chance to apply those skills where they'll shape the next generation.

At Alpha, students don't spend their days listening to lectures. They master academics through adaptive technology while Guides focus on coaching, motivation, accountability, and life skills. As a Lead Guide, you'll build the team that makes this model work—coaching Guides, developing leaders, and creating an environment where students consistently exceed expectations.

This is not an instructional coaching role, and it is not classroom teaching. You won't spend your days reviewing lesson plans or observing lectures because there aren't any. Instead, you'll build a culture of excellence by coaching Guides, leading engaging life skills workshops, and motivating students to achieve ambitious goals. Your success will be measured by the quality of students' experiences, your team's performance, and your ability to maintain uncompromising standards while inspiring others to meet them.

Alpha is building the world's best K-12 experience. That requires leaders who have already proven they can raise others' performance, make objective, data-driven decisions, and embrace bold new ideas rather than protecting outdated traditions. If that describes you, we'd love to meet you.

This role is currently open at select Alpha campuses: Boston, MA; Raleigh, NC; New York City, NY; Greenwich, CT; and Washington, DC.

If you're located in one of these markets—or excited to relocate—we'd love to hear from you. Exceptional candidates outside these locations are also encouraged to apply. As Alpha continues to grow, we regularly match outstanding leaders with opportunities across our expanding network of campuses.

What You Will Be Doing

Coaching Guides to consistently deliver exceptional student experiences while maintaining Alpha's high standards.
Leading engaging life skills workshops that develop communication, leadership, focus, and other real-world skills for K-12 students.
Motivating students to achieve ambitious learning goals and maximize progress in their self-directed academic programs.
Using data, observation, and coaching conversations to improve Guide performance and student outcomes.
Helping launch and establish new Alpha campuses by building a culture centered on excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What You Won’t Be Doing

Teaching traditional academic classes or delivering subject-matter lectures.
Writing lesson plans or designing curriculum.
Lowering standards to make students feel successful instead of helping them achieve real mastery.
Managing a team from behind a desk without regularly coaching students and Guides firsthand.
Preserving outdated practices simply because "that's how we've always done it."

Youth Program Manager Key Responsibilities

Ensure every student consistently experiences Alpha's three promises by building high-performing Guides, delivering engaging life skills experiences, and maintaining uncompromising standards for student success.

Basic Requirements

Willingness to work on-site at an Alpha campus (relocation support available): Boston, MA; Raleigh, NC; New York City, NY; Greenwich, CT; Washington, DC
Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, Business, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
At least 5 years of experience in education, coaching, learning and development, or a related leadership role.
Experience leading and developing teams of five or more people, including hiring and making performance-based termination decisions.
Demonstrated success using data to drive performance improvements.
Experience working with children ages 5-14 in an educational, coaching, or developmental setting.
Experience building or launching a new team, program, business, school, or initiative, with willingness to help open a new campus from zero.
Willingness to work in a school model that rejects traditional lecture-based pedagogy.
Legal authorization to work in the United States.

Nice-to-have Requirements

Experience coaching youth through athletics, debate, camps, or extracurricular programs.
Exceptional public speaking and storytelling skills.
A track record of achieving high levels of academic, professional, or athletic performance.
Experience motivating teams through ambitious goals while maintaining high accountability.
A passion for challenging conventional education and helping shape a new model for K-12 learning.

About Alpha

Join the team building school around student growth

Alpha reimagines the school day around faster learning, stronger mentorship, and more time for students to build real-world skills.

Roles with real student impact:
Alpha hires teachers (guides), operators, admissions experts, school & curriculum leaders, and remote team members.

Education work that pays like it matters:
Alpha offers six-figure roles for people ready to help build a radically better school experience.

A culture built for builders:
Alpha is fast-moving, ambitious, and student focused. It’s for people who want to improve the system, not maintain it.

Alpha is where you can do the most meaningful work of your career.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

Working with us

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Software
jobs.description:
About Mind

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

About The Team And The Role

Program Management at Mind is an operational catalyst. We own outcomes, drive the trade-offs that keep engineering moving, and set the metabolic rate of the teams we partner with — clearing roadblocks, closing stalled decisions, carrying risk upward, and protecting the focus engineers need to build. As a Software Program Manager you will own the integrated program plan across all of software and build the practice itself: how teams define their own milestones and commit to org-level ones, how we know week over week whether we are on or off track, and how problems surface early enough that we can still do something about them. You will partner directly with hardware program management so that software and hardware roll up into one program picture rather than two competing ones.

Responsibilities

End-to-End Ownership: Own the software program plan end to end — from roadmap planning through implementation, integration, validation, and release to the fleet — and own the functional outcome, not just the schedule.
Program Practice Design: Establish how software program management works at Mind: the planning rhythm that connects team-level work to org-level milestones, what qualifies as a milestone, what "done" means at each one, and the artifacts that support both the individual engineer and leadership in prioritization and decision making.
Milestone Planning: Build software plans that align with org-level milestones, including clear definitions of what “done” means at each step.
Metric Tracking: Monitor and report on key program metrics, and communicate status, blockers, and risks to leadership.
Progress Tracking & Status Integrity: Build the tracking layer that answers whether we are on or off track, drawn from the systems teams already work in.
Risk Mitigation: Identify and escalate technical, dependency, and resourcing risks early, and and drive them to resolution.
Technical / Business Judgment: Engage directly in architecture and design discussions at a depth sufficient to stress-test engineering estimates and pressure-test readiness. Drive decisions at that level with understanding of the impacts to our business goals.

Requirements

Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in engineering (software / computer science preferred), or equivalent experience.
Industry Experience: 5+ years of experience in technical program management for software products, ideally in robotics, autonomous systems, or another domain where software ships against hardware and real-world deployment constraints.
Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success taking software from early development through release and sustained operation.
Technical Depth: Strong software fundamentals with the ability to engage meaningfully in architecture, planning, and systems integration discussions.
System Complexity: Experience managing programs spanning multiple interdependent software domains along with their dependencies on hardware revisions and the availability of test hardware.
Execution & Ownership: High sense of urgency, comfortable with ambiguity, and driven by an "engineering curiosity" to understand how the entire system works.

Reporting to the Manager of GURU, the Senior Project Manager (PM) is responsible and accountable for planning, development, and delivery of a variety of operational and research initiatives related to the development and maintenance of provincial cancer guidelines, pathways, and other evidence-based resources. new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Toku, we create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions to reimagine customer experiences for enterprises. We provide an end-to-end approach to help businesses overcome the complexity of digital transformation and deliver mission-critical CX through cloud communication solutions. Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional in-country infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve the diverse needs of enterprises operating at scale. Headquartered in Singapore, Toku supports customers across APAC and beyond, with a growing footprint across global markets. As a publicly listed company, Toku continues to scale its presence and impact across international markets.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you will lead the successful delivery of complex enterprise system integration projects across APAC and global markets, acting as the primary delivery owner for clients, partners, vendors and internal teams. Beyond project execution, you will help strengthen project management standards, mentor less experienced project managers, and drive greater operational maturity as Toku continues to scale internationally. Success in this role depends on combining strong technical understanding with excellent stakeholder management, commercial awareness, sound project governance, and the ability to adapt across different countries, time zones and customer environments.

What you will be doing

Enterprise Project Delivery:
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technical implementation and system integration projects, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within budget and to agreed quality standards across multiple workstreams.
Project Planning & Governance:
Own integrated project plans covering scope, schedules, budgets, dependencies, assumptions, resources, milestones and governance activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Technical Leadership:
Work confidently with solution architects, consultants and engineering teams to understand technical designs, infrastructure, cloud environments and integration approaches, enabling informed delivery decisions and effective issue resolution.
System Integration:
Manage complex integration programmes involving enterprise platforms, contact centre technologies, CRM solutions, cloud services and connectivity components while ensuring all technical deliverables align with client requirements.
Stakeholder Management:
Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers, government stakeholders where applicable, internal delivery teams, partners and vendors by providing clear communication, governance and proactive expectation management.
Resource & Delivery Management:
Coordinate project resources across multiple countries and functions, balancing delivery priorities while maintaining visibility of resource utilisation, delivery risks and overall project health using Jira and related project management tools.
RAID Management:
Own project risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies by identifying potential delivery challenges early, driving mitigation plans and escalating blockers before they impact project outcomes.
Testing & Go-Live:
Coordinate testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), production readiness and deployment activities with consulting, engineering and client teams to ensure successful implementation and transition into production.
Commercial & Financial Oversight:
Monitor project budgets, effort burn, payment milestones, commercial commitments and change requests, ensuring delivery remains commercially sustainable while providing early visibility of potential impacts.
Project Reporting:
Produce accurate executive-level reporting covering project progress, delivery status, financial health, governance updates, risks, decisions and next steps for both customers and internal leadership.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales and Solution Engineering to provide delivery insights, identify commercial risks, support solution transitions into delivery, and highlight opportunities for additional services or change requests where appropriate.
Continuous Improvement:
Help strengthen project management methodologies, reporting standards, governance frameworks and delivery consistency as Toku scales its global project delivery capability.
Mentoring & Leadership:
Mentor and coach less experienced project managers, promote best practices, and provide senior project leadership across the wider delivery organisation.
Global Delivery:
Successfully manage projects across multiple countries and regions while remaining flexible to collaborate across different time zones and travel internationally when required.
AI & Automation:
Continuously identify opportunities to improve project delivery through AI-powered reporting, workflow automation, Copilot agents and other productivity tools that reduce administrative effort and improve delivery effectiveness.

We'd love to hear from you if you have

Experience:
5–10 years of project or programme management experience delivering complex enterprise technology or system integration projects.
Project Management Certifications:
PMP or PRINCE2 certification is required.
Enterprise Delivery:
Strong experience delivering projects for medium to large enterprise organisations, with exposure to large stakeholder environments and structured delivery methodologies.
Technical Background:
Practical experience managing technical implementations involving system integration, infrastructure, cloud platforms and enterprise software, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions without necessarily being a hands-on engineer.
Project Governance:
Extensive hands-on experience using Jira for project planning, delivery tracking, governance and reporting.
Cloud Technologies:
Experience delivering projects involving cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Contact Centre & Communications Technologies (preferred but not required):
Practical knowledge of CCaaS, CPaaS, CTI, enterprise contact centre architectures and the wider cloud communications industry, including familiarity with major vendors such as Genesys, Avaya and similar platforms.
Enterprise Platforms:
Experience delivering or integrating enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow and Salesforce. Familiarity with Remedy/BMC or similar enterprise service management platforms would also be advantageous.
Connectivity & Telecommunications:
Experience within telecommunications, network infrastructure or connectivity-related projects would be highly valued, particularly where enterprise provisioning or carrier integrations have been involved.
CRM & Enterprise Applications:
Experience working with CRM platforms and enterprise business applications across cloud and on-premise environments.
Agile Delivery:
Experience working within Agile software delivery environments and collaborating closely with engineering teams.
IT Understanding:
Good practical understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management practices.
AI Productivity:
Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve project delivery, reporting, workflow automation or operational efficiency within day-to-day project management activities.
Industry Experience:
Experience supporting government, public sector or healthcare customers would be advantageous. Experience with Singapore Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) environments would be considered a strong advantage.
Communication:
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead governance discussions and manage complex client relationships.
Working Style:
Comfortable working across international time zones, travelling internationally when required, and adapting to the needs of global enterprise project delivery.
Location:
This role is to be based in KL, Malaysia, operating on a Hybrid work mode of WFO and WFH

Toku has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Startup and by the Financial Times as one of APAC’s Top 500 High Growth Companies. If you’re looking to be part of a company on a strong growth trajectory while working on meaningful, real-world challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

EGF aims to transform the lives and livelihoods of the people of Africa socially and economically by equipping them, capacity building and linking them to modern, inclusive financial services that maximize their opportunities. Since its inception, EGF has led high-impact development programs in East and Central Africa in the fields of Education and Leadership Development; Food and Agriculture; Enterprise Development and Financial Inclusion (ED&FI); Energy, Environment & Climate Change; Social Protection; and Health. EGF has adopted Innovation & Technology as a leverage to expand its reach, efficiency in program delivery and impact at scale, as well as Advocacy to advance social change through awareness, mobilizing partnerships and championing relevant policy change.

The Role Purpose

Reporting to the Pillar Lead, the Program Manager is responsible for the design, implementation, performance management, and continuous improvement of Enterprise Development & Financial Inclusion programs that drive enterprise growth, financial inclusion, innovation, and sustainable economic opportunities. The role translates strategy into scalable, technology-enabled interventions that strengthen enterprise capability, improve productivity, expand access to finance, strengthen market participation, and support business growth among MSMEs, youth, women, and other underserved populations. The Program Manager provides technical leadership in assigned thematic areas while leveraging technology, data, ecosystem partnerships, and innovation to achieve impact at scale. The role also ensures strong governance, risk management, compliance, financial stewardship, and operational controls to safeguard program integrity and maximize value for beneficiaries, partners, donors, and Equity Group stakeholders.

The Key Responsibilities

Support the design and delivery of programs within the Enterprise Development pillar that aligns with the strategic objectives of EGF under assigned thematic areas.
Lead the design, planning, implementation, and continuous improvement of ED&FI programs and initiatives within assigned thematic areas.
Drive enterprise growth, job creation, financial inclusion, and livelihood improvement outcomes through effective delivery of capacity building, business development, market linkage, and financial access interventions.
Manage program performance, budgets, work plans, risks, compliance requirements, and reporting to ensure quality, efficiency, and achievement of program targets.
Build and manage strategic partnerships with donors, government agencies, financial institutions, private sector players, ecosystem actors, and development partners to strengthen program delivery and sustainability.
Provide technical leadership and thought leadership within assigned practice areas, contributing to innovation, program development, and resource mobilization efforts.
Lead, coach, and develop high-performing program teams while promoting a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
Oversee monitoring, evaluation, learning, knowledge management, and impact measurement processes to support evidence-based decision-making and program effectiveness.
Champion business growth and financial inclusion by facilitating access to finance, market opportunities, digital solutions, and relevant enterprise support services for beneficiaries.
Develop stakeholder reports, impact stories, knowledge products, and management updates that effectively communicate program achievements, lessons learned, and strategic value.
Represent EGF in relevant forums, partnerships, and ecosystem engagements while strengthening the visibility and positioning of the ED&FI pillar.

Core Accountabilities And Deliverables

Financial: Program budget preparation, management, and utilization, Resource mobilization and partnership development, Contribution to customer acquisition, financial inclusion, and access-to-finance outcomes, Support growth in enterprise financing and uptake of financial services.
Processes: Quality program design and implementation, Delivery against approved work plans, budgets, and targets, Compliance with organizational policies, donor requirements, and audit standards and accurate, timely, and actionable reporting
Customers and clients: Delivery of impactful enterprise development and financial inclusion interventions, Increased customer satisfaction, enterprise growth, and financial capability, strengthened access to finance, markets, and business support services, enhanced inclusion of youth, women, and underserved segment.
People: Supervision and development of program staff, Performance management, coaching, and mentorship, Team engagement, capability building, and succession planning, Promotion of a high-performance and learning culture

Strong understanding of entrepreneurship for economic and social outcomes, the MSME sector in Kenya, East and Central Africa region.
Demonstrated experience managing risks, controls, compliance requirements, and governance processes within donor-funded, financial services, or development environments.
Experience supporting growth-oriented enterprises to improve competitiveness, access markets, attract finance, and scale operations will be an added advantage.
Experience designing and implementing entrepreneurship, startup, innovation, youth employment, or future skills programs will be an added advantage.
